title: IRONWEED PLI delivery and rates: deferred to site config (decided)
description: DECIDED (Mark 2026-10-17): defer. PLI delivery model and reporting rates are site/operator configuration; the spec sets no defaults. Record (as an IRONWEED tracker note, not a spec rule) that per-observer CoAP Observe delivery scales with N x (N-1) and large nets should prefer multicast.
